recipes.name: Lemon and oregano chicken skewers
recipes.method_note: Soak wooden skewers in water 30 minutes first so they do not burn.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks.
Mix {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:dried-oregano}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Coat the chicken. Leave 20 minutes.
Cut {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} into chunks. Thread onto skewers with the chicken.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 12 minutes, turning often, until cooked through.
Serve with {{ing:tzatziki}}.

recipes.method_note: Soak wooden skewers in water 30 minutes first so they do not burn.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:beef-sirloin}} into chunks.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:mirin}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Coat the steak. Leave 20 minutes.
Cut {{ing:spring-onion}} into chunks. Thread onto skewers with the steak.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 6 minutes, turning often, until browned but pink inside.
Scatter with {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

recipes.name: Harissa steak skewers with yoghurt
recipes.method_note: Soak wooden skewers in water 30 minutes first so they do not burn.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:beef-sirloin}} into chunks.

Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 6 minutes, turning often, until browned but pink inside.
Serve with {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Steak skewers with chimichurri
recipes.method_note: Soak wooden skewers in water 30 minutes first so they do not burn.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:beef-sirloin}} into chunks.
Mix {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}. Coat the steak in half. Leave 20 minutes.
Cut {{ing:pepper-bell}} into chunks. Thread onto skewers with the steak.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 6 minutes, turning often, until browned but pink inside.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}} with {{ing:dried-oregano}}. Stir into the rest of the marinade. Spoon over.

recipes.name: Satay steak skewers

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:beef-sirloin}} into chunks.

Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 6 minutes, turning often, until browned but pink inside.
Warm {{ing:peanut-butter}} with half of {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Serve for dipping.

steps.instruction: Brush {{ing:mackerel-fillet}} with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill skin side towards the heat 3 minutes.
Turn. Grill 1 minutes more, until cooked as you like it.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Scatter {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Mix {{ing:harissa-paste}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Brush over {{ing:mackerel-fillet}}.

recipes.name: Lamb burgers with feta and mint

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:lamb-mince}} with {{ing:cumin-ground}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}}. Shape into 4 burgers.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 4 minutes a side, until cooked through.
Toast {{ing:burger-bun}} on the grill.
Fill with the burgers, crumbled {{ing:feta}} and sliced {{ing:cucumber}}.
Halve {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} through the middle to make 4 thin pieces.
Rub with {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 4 minutes a side, until cooked through.
Fill {{ing:burger-bun}} with chicken, sliced {{ing:avocado}}, {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} and {{ing:mayonnaise}}.
Grate {{ing:apple-medium}}. Chop {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Mix into {{ing:pork-mince}}. Shape into 4 burgers.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 5 minutes a side, until cooked through.
Toast {{ing:burger-bun}}.
Fill with burgers, {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}} and {{ing:rocket}}.

recipes.name: Grilled aubergine with tahini and pomegranate

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:aubergine}} into rounds. Brush with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 4 minutes a side, until soft and striped.
Whisk {{ing:tahini}} with {{ing:lemon}} juice and water to a drizzle.
Pour over. Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Grilled peppers with feta and basil

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:pepper-bell}} into wide strips.
Brush with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 4 minutes a side, until charred.
Crumble over {{ing:feta}}. Add {{ing:fresh-basil}}, the rest of the oil and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Mix {{ing:olive-oil}}, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves.
Brush over {{ing:portobello-mushroom}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 5 minutes a side, until juicy.

recipes.name: Grilled courgette, lemon and ricotta salad

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:courgette}} lengthways. Brush with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 2 minutes a side, until striped.
Lay on a plate. Dot with {{ing:ricotta}}.
Dress with the rest of the oil, {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.

recipes.name: Grilled corn with lime and chilli

steps.instruction: Brush {{ing:corn-on-the-cob}} with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 10 minutes, turning, until charred all over.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}. Sprinkle {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Slice {{ing:halloumi}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Cube {{ing:watermelon}}. Toss with {{ing:fresh-mint}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:lime}} juice.
Top with the hot halloumi.

recipes.name: Grilled sweet potato with chilli and lime

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:sweet-potato}} into rounds. Boil 5 minutes. Drain.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 3 minutes a side, until charred.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}. Scatter {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Grilled figs with honey and yoghurt

steps.instruction: Halve {{ing:figs-fresh}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill cut side down 3 minutes.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}. Serve with {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

recipes.name: Grilled plums with maple and coconut yoghurt

steps.instruction: Halve and stone {{ing:plums}}. Brush with {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill cut side down 4 minutes, until soft.
Serve with {{ing:coconut-yoghurt}}.
Halve {{ing:banana-medium}} lengthways in their skins.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill cut side down 4 minutes.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}. Bubble 2 minutes. Stir in {{ing:double-cream}}.
Serve the bananas with the sauce and {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}}.

recipes.name: Grilled peaches with almonds and cream

steps.instruction: Halve and stone {{ing:peach}}. Sprinkle the cut sides with {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill cut side down 4 minutes, until caramelised.
Serve with {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and chopped {{ing:almonds}}.
Slice {{ing:halloumi}} into 4 thick slabs.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Toast {{ing:burger-bun}}. Fill with halloumi, sliced {{ing:tomato-medium}}, {{ing:rocket}} and {{ing:tzatziki}}.
Rub {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} with {{ing:jerk-paste}}.
Heat a griddle pan, the grill or the barbecue until very hot.
Grill 6 minutes a side, until cooked through.
Dice a quarter of {{ing:pineapple}} with {{ing:red-onion}}, {{ing:lime}} juice and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Spoon over.
